judge_prompt: You are grading a support reply. Answer pass if it answers the customer's question correctly and politely, otherwise fail. Reply with one word.
pair_prompt: Here are two replies to the same customer message, Reply 1 and Reply 2. Which is better? Answer 1 or 2.
human_raters: simulated: two raters, each wrong on 7% of replies, independently

planted_biases.length: a bad reply of 120 words or more passes 45% of the time, a shorter bad reply 10%
planted_biases.position: in a pair, the reply shown first gets 15 extra points of chance to win
